_comment: Wall-clock seconds for one bats file in its own bats call on a GitHub windows-latest runner, Node 20. Used ONLY to balance CI shards -- never to gate anything. Stale numbers cost balance, never correctness: shard-tests.mjs asserts every file lands in exactly one shard whether or not it appears here.
_why: arc-ci's windows leg costs 1585s against ~145s on ubuntu for the same 563 tests -- 2.82s per test against 0.26s, because every bats `run` spawns a process and windows process creation is dear. Measured 2026-07-31 (run 30611012771): excluding the workspace and bats' binaries from Microsoft Defender changes nothing, because the runner image already ships with realtime protection OFF and both drives excluded. There is no windows-side saving left to find, so the fix stays splitting.
_provenance: ALL 165 discovered files re-measured on the MERGED tree, 2026-08-23 (run 32648129763, weigh-tests.yml, on main at 761d4ae1) -- one file per job on windows-latest, Node 20, scanners installed exactly as arc-ci installs them. This REPLACES the branch-measured pass from earlier the same day, which was taken at 0c2ea84c before three suites gained tests and is invalidated by the merge (.claude/rules/lanes.md: a measured table regenerated on a branch is invalidated by the merge, re-measure on the merged tree). The three entries that under-reported there are now measured for real -- engine-hermes-secrets moved 58 -> 96 across the tests added after that run, which is the size of the error a hand-written adjustment would have introduced. MERGE NOTE 2026-08-24: the face lane landed after this measurement, adding three test files and changing others. Every number below is still a real measurement on a real tree; it is simply a tree that has since moved, which the _known_gap entry quantifies rather than hides.
_evidence: The 2026-08-10 pass measured 104 files, 44 of which had NO entry at all and were riding _default_weight 16. The two this slice grew were among them and wrong in the same direction by roughly sevenfold: leads-journey.bats 111s and leads-mail-guard.bats 120s. (An earlier version of this sentence said 47 covered; 47 was the count MISSING before the run, 44 of them were measured, and the other 3 are the ones _known_gap names.) The method is unchanged from the pass that produced the previous table: one file per job on windows, each timed in its own bats call with the scanners arc-ci installs. 2026-08-13: the bench cycle added four files -- bench-core, bench-drift, bench-proposal and bench-seal -- and every one of them was riding _default_weight 16 until this pass. They measured 38s, 32s, 37s and 80s: bench-seal alone was under-weighted FIVEFOLD, because each of these runs a probe that spawns full K=3 bench runs. That is the same shape as the 2026-08-10 gap, one cycle later, and it is why an unmeasured entry has to be visible as a COUNT rather than absorbed into a default. 2026-08-13 (second pass, post-merge): scheduler's five jobs-*.bats files are now measured rather than defaulted. The five bench files measured RED in this pass and were NOT re-weighted -- see _known_gap.
_floor: DERIVED FROM THE TABLE, NOT REMEMBERED: the heaviest single file is the floor no shard count can beat, because one file cannot be split across shards. On the merged-tree pass that is sync.bats at 186s, with spine-emit.bats at 174s second and design-steel-thread.bats at 131s third. Whoever pastes a new block re-derives these three from the top of the timings map in the same commit, or the note lies again -- it already did once, naming a floor that two later passes had overtaken.
_known_gap: UNMEASURED, AND COUNTED SO THE GAP IS VISIBLE RATHER THAN DEFAULTED: 3 file(s) -- face-coverage.bats, face-dash.bats, face-l3.bats. This entry read NONE until the face lane merged on 2026-08-24 and brought three test files the 2026-08-23 pass could not have seen. That is the shape this repo keeps paying for -- a field accurate when written and silently falsified by a later change -- and it is why `.claude/rules/lanes.md` says a measured table regenerated on a branch is invalidated by the merge. A weigh-tests pass on the merged tree is dispatched; until it lands these three ride _default_weight and the windows leg packs 12 shards from a table that is short by three files.
